integrity: The exact generating functions are independently re-derived algebraically from the cited source. Numerical replay is auxiliary and is not used as a substitute for the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the symmetric semi-infinite binary-tree discrete-time walk and the source run-time proxy; no claim for other coins, boundaries, finite trees, or measured first-hitting protocols. The exponential rate and limiting linear optimizer are proved; the complete polynomial prefactor is not evaluated.
title: Exact exponential speedup exponent for the symmetric binary-tree quantum walk
